notice: Training only. Fictional product and trial.

scenario.indication: Resistant hypertension on three antihypertensive agents
scenario.moa: Selective antagonist of a fictional vascular receptor, reducing peripheral resistance without affecting heart rate or renal potassium handling.
scenario.preclinical: Sustained blood-pressure reduction in a salt-sensitive rat model; clean 13-week toxicology with a wide NOAEL margin and no QT liability.
scenario.known: Wide therapeutic margin and predictable, mechanism-based pharmacology.
scenario.unknown: Human dose-response, food effect, and whether benefit is preserved on top of three background agents.
scenario.surrogate: Change in 24-hour ambulatory systolic blood pressure

labels.p2_endpoint: Surrogate / intermediate endpoint — Change in 24-hour ambulatory systolic blood pressure
labels.p2_comparator: Add-on placebo-controlled (all patients keep standard of care)
labels.p2_size: Power on a conservative, clinically meaningful effect at 80-90% power
labels.p3_endpoint: Change from baseline in 24-hour ambulatory systolic BP at week 12
labels.p3_size: Power on a discounted Phase II effect, with dropout allowance
labels.p3_interim: Group-sequential design with alpha-spending and hierarchical secondary testing
labels.p3_inclusion: Broad and representative, with pre-specified subgroups
